rowKeys.notes: Golden row uses reserved source_id = __ir (single Get = 360). Contributory rows use the real source_id.
asset_id = source-native id (account no / policy no / GSTIN / doc no), hashed if long.

rowKeys.layout: salt(1) · IR_Key(16) · event_type(code) · reverse_ts(8) · source_id · record_id
rowKeys.notes: event_type includes observation. Salt subject-derived so per-subject history stays contiguous.

rowKeys.layout: salt(1) · IR_Key_A(16) · rel_type(code) · IR_Key_B(16) · source_id · record_id
rowKeys.notes: Dual-written; salt from the leading key of each stored direction.
version = reverse_ts (point-in-time) or latest-version Get (online serving).
dimension in {source, provider, consent}; value = the id. Scan = all rows to purge.
Qualifiers: ir_key (surviving), verification_status, source_id, valid_from/to. Sensitive values tokenized/hashed in key; resolves via ir_alias; deleted with subject/source/consent purge.
